summary: ICZOOM Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 11, 2026, announcing a 5-for-1 share consolidation (reverse stock split) approved by its board on July 27, 2026, effective at the open on September 15, 2026. The stated objective is to regain compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) and preserve its Nasdaq listing. Outstanding Class A shares fall from 8,188,610 to about 1,637,722 and Class B from 3,829,500 to about 765,900, subject to rounding, with no fractional shares issued. Shares trade under the same symbol IZM but a new CUSIP, G4760B118. No advisor, price, or premium was disclosed. Watch post-split trading and Nasdaq bid-price compliance.
